Hollow Rat.Name: Hollow Rat
RoomDescriptions: The passage opens into a low cavern slick with black moisture. Pale fungi cling to the walls, casting a weak blue glow across the stone.
Broken columns rise from the floor like shattered ribs. Deep claw marks run across several of them, far above your head.
A pool of perfectly black water fills most of the chamber. Every few moments, ripples form across its surface despite the still air.
Thick strands of webbing cover the walls and ceiling. Several old bones and pieces of rusted equipment are tangled inside.
The ceiling disappears into darkness. Every sound you make returns several seconds later, distorted and from the wrong direction.
Clusters of luminous mushrooms surround the remains of an abandoned campsite. A cold fire pit sits at its center.
A narrow stone bridge stretches across a fissure whose bottom cannot be seen. Warm air rises steadily from below.
Strange symbols have been carved into every wall. Most are ancient and worn, but several appear disturbingly fresh.
Dozens of small holes cover the cavern walls. Something occasionally shifts just beyond the openings.
A massive stone statue has collapsed across the chamber. Its face has been deliberately smashed beyond recognition.
Broken weapons and damaged armor lie scattered across the floor. Some of the blood coating them is still wet.
Dense gray mist hangs close to the ground. Shapes seem to move within it whenever you look away.
An underground stream cuts through the chamber. Dark water carries fragments of bone deeper into the caves.
Pale roots grow through cracks in the walls and floor. They slowly expand and contract as though breathing.
Crude stone grave markers fill the room. Several graves appear to have been opened from the inside.
Purple crystals protrude from the stone and emit a faint humming sound that grows louder when approached.
The remains of an old wooden barricade block part of the chamber. Something powerful has smashed through it from the other side.
Frost covers the walls despite the humid tunnels surrounding the room. Your breath becomes visible as you enter.
A circular symbol has been painted across the floor using dried blood. Burned-out candles surround it.
The cavern is completely silent. Even your footsteps seem strangely muted.
